title: Hotel Zamkowy at Książ
visualBrief: Detached cream hotel with a red hip roof, a joined cross gable, two low dormers and a recessed forecourt entrance.

nativeAxes.origin: Mapped building envelope center. The terrain reference is the toe of the forecourt entrance apron.

sourceFacts.primaryDescription: The National Heritage Institute records the former tax office at Piastów Śląskich 5 under PL.1.9.ZIPOZ.NID_N_02_BK.92980. A labeled aerial identifies the same detached building as Hotel Zamkowy.

reconstruction.basis: Attributed OpenStreetMap outline, labeled aerial and operator aerial. The National Heritage Institute record confirms the former tax office at number 5.
reconstruction.scope: Detached historic building identified by its own address and footprint within the Książ estate inventory. The broader estate remains in progress.
reconstruction.registration: The east-facing gable follows the photographed orientation. The sandstone plinth meets the retained PMTiles terrain and a reconstructed recessed entrance and landing join the forecourt grade.

buildingCutout.basis: Exact retained Protomaps outline for the former tax office at Piastów Śląskich 5.

groundCutout.basis: The model supplies the ground below the entrance steps. Clear inferred parking pavement between the principal façade and the outer approach while keeping the mapped service roads.

Footprint is attributed map geometry;heights,openings,dormers and roof profiles are photographic interpretations.
The aerials establish the roof and main façade. Precise door details and the sandstone approach are reconstructed.

Exterior floor and plinth elevations follow the retained terrain samples. Roof profiles, facade details and opposite elevations are reconstructions. No interiors, custom textures or measured device timings.
